accordion.title: Accordion
accordion.description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal a section of content.

alert.title: Alert
alert.description: Displays a callout for user attention.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.description: An image element with a fallback, plus badge/status indicators and grouping via AvatarGroup.

badge.title: Badge
badge.description: Displays a badge or a component that looks like a badge.

breadcrumb.title: Breadcrumb
breadcrumb.description: Displays the path to the current resource using a hierarchy of links.

bento-grid.title: BentoGrid
bento-grid.description: A CSS-grid layout for unevenly-sized cards ("bento box" layouts).

button.title: Button
button.description: Displays a button or a component that looks like a button, plus ButtonGroup for joined rows/columns.

checkbox.title: CheckboxGroup
checkbox.description: A group of Checkboxes sharing a single array value.

chip.title: Chip
chip.description: A compact, interactive element for displaying status, categories, or filters.

code-block.title: CodeBlock
code-block.description: A syntax-highlighted code block with a copy-to-clipboard button.

collapsible.title: Collapsible
collapsible.description: An interactive component which expands/collapses a single panel.

color-picker.title: ColorPicker
color-picker.description: A color swatch + hex text input, kept in sync with the browser's native color picker.

column-menu.title: ColumnMenu
column-menu.description: A dropdown to show/hide and reorder (drag and drop) the columns of a table.

combobox.title: Combobox
combobox.description: An autocomplete/searchable select, plus MultiSelect for multi-value selection.

command-palette.title: CommandPalette
command-palette.description: A global command menu (Cmd/Ctrl+K to open).

confirm-dialog.title: ConfirmDialog
confirm-dialog.description: Provides useConfirm, an imperative `await confirm({...})` alternative to hand-wiring an AlertDialog.

count-animation.title: CountAnimation
count-animation.description: Animates a number counting up (or down) to a value whenever it changes.

date-picker.title: DatePicker
date-picker.description: A single-date picker built on a Popover + Calendar recipe.

description-list.title: DescriptionList
description-list.description: A description list, with terms and descriptions.

dropdrawer.title: Dropdrawer
dropdrawer.description: A menu that renders as a DropdownMenu on desktop and a bottom Drawer on mobile.

dropzone.title: Dropzone
dropzone.description: A drag-and-drop file upload zone, listing accepted files below.

field.title: Field
field.description: Wires a label, description and error message to a single form control.

file-list.title: FileList
file-list.description: Displays a list of files with details such as name, size, and upload progress.

gradient-frame.title: GradientFrame
gradient-frame.description: A visual laid on an offset, gradient-filled frame.

icon-bubble.title: IconBubble
icon-bubble.description: An icon inside a round, tinted bubble.

image-input.title: ImageInput
image-input.description: A click-to-upload image picker with a live preview.

infinite-scroll.title: InfiniteScroll
infinite-scroll.description: Calls onLoadMore once a sentinel at the bottom of children scrolls into view.

kbd.title: Kbd
kbd.description: Displays which key or combination of keys performs a given action.

locale.title: UiLocale
locale.description: The French/English built-in labels shared by the components, plus UiLocaleProvider.

link.title: Link
link.description: A styled hyperlink, or a component that looks like one, plus LinkPreview for hover-triggered metadata cards.

marquee.title: Marquee
marquee.description: Infinitely scrolls its children (a logo wall, a ticker).

multi-step-loader.title: MultiStepLoader
multi-step-loader.description: A full-screen overlay stepping through a sequence of loading messages.

navbar.title: Navbar
navbar.description: A fixed, floating page header that visually shrinks on scroll, plus a mobile menu.

notification-center.title: NotificationCenter
notification-center.description: A bell-icon trigger with an unread-count badge, opening a popover list of notifications.

number-input.title: NumberInput
number-input.description: A numeric input with increment/decrement stepper buttons.

pagination.title: Pagination
pagination.description: Navigates between pages of a paginated set, computing the visible page numbers and ellipses.

password-input.title: PasswordInput
password-input.description: A password Input with a show/hide visibility toggle, plus a strength meter.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Displays an indicator showing the completion progress of a task.

qr-code.title: QrCode
qr-code.description: Generates a QR code from a string, rendered as inline SVG.

radio.title: RadioCard
radio.description: A card-style RadioGroup item — the whole card is the clickable target.

rating.title: Rating
rating.description: A star rating control with keyboard navigation and hover preview.

relative-time.title: RelativeTime
relative-time.description: Displays a live-updating relative time ("2 minutes ago").

reparent.title: Reparent
reparent.description: Moves children between different container elements at different breakpoints.

repeat.title: Repeat
repeat.description: Repeats a component a specified number of times.

scroll-progress.title: ScrollProgress
scroll-progress.description: A fixed bar tracking scroll percentage of the page or a container.

scroll-shadow.title: ScrollShadow
scroll-shadow.description: A vertically-scrollable container with fade-out gradient shadows at the edges.

scrollspy.title: Scrollspy
scrollspy.description: Tracks which of the given element ids is currently scrolled into view.

snippet.title: Snippet
snippet.description: Displays and copies code in a tabbed interface.

sortable.title: Sortable
sortable.description: A drag-to-reorder list built on native HTML5 drag events.

spacer.title: Spacer
spacer.description: Adds space between components — a flexible filler or a fixed gap.

spinner.title: Spinner
spinner.description: An accessible loading indicator, in one of a few visual styles.

stepper.title: Stepper
stepper.description: A numbered sequence of steps for a multi-stage flow.

submit-button.title: SubmitButton
submit-button.description: A submit Button that shows its own loading state automatically via useFormStatus.

tags-input.title: TagsInput
tags-input.description: A flexible input for adding/removing multiple tags.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.description: A vertical sequence of dated events, connected by a line.

toggle-switch.title: ToggleSwitch
toggle-switch.description: An on/off switch with an optional visible label and description.

tree.title: Tree
tree.description: A hierarchical, expandable/collapsible list of nodes.
